description: SOMOS UMA EQUIPE FORMADA PARA PENSAR EM SOLUÇÕES CRIATIVAS NO AMBITO ESPACIAL, VAMOS COMEÇAR COM APP DE SIMULAÇÃO DE MISSÕES ESPACIAS DO COMEÇO AO FIM.
summary: ASTRIX11 is a simulator for space mission design. Students and aspiring engineers currently lack tools for planning, simulating, and reviewing space missions. So, with the help of coding agents, we built a browser-based game and simulator to provide an end-to-end mission design experience. The simulator is powered by real NASA data and resources.
details: ASTRIX11 is a space mission design game, it works by allowing students and aspiring engineers to plan, simulate and review space missions with an interactive interface. It benefits students by giving a full overview of how missions work allowing them to think systemically and visually consequences of their decisions. We expect to help engineers to be more equipped to study and tackle mission design which advances science as a whole. The technology stack is Typescript, React, Three.js. ASTRIX11 solves the challenge in a creative way by using a browser based simulator that allows players to make meaningful and visual decisions for mission design in an interactive cockpit-like interface.
dataRefs: Visualize a Space Mission Using Virtual Reality
